name: ROCm HIP GPU TOP_K fix
canonical_description: Routes ggml_top_k onto the GPU on ROCm/HIP backends where the stock path falls back to CPU, restoring qwen4exp decode scaling with context depth.
mechanism: Stock HIP has no CUB past ne=1024, so the QSA indexer's ggml_top_k over the whole context collapses decode with depth (knee at exactly d1024). Fixed either with hipCUB (llama.cpp PR #26592) or a native radix implementation (PR #27466).
constraints: Applies to ROCm/HIP builds hitting the ne=1024 CPU-fallback knee; not relevant to CUDA/Metal/Vulkan paths.
Recorded on a custom branch; the fix is not mainline until the cited PRs merge.
tradeoffs: hipCUB adds a dependency surface; native radix avoids it but is a separate code path.
TOP_K is one lever of a bundle; this packet does not attribute end-to-end speedups by itself.
re_review_triggers: PR #26592 or #27466 merges into llama.cpp mainline.
A HIP change removes the ne=1024 CPU-fallback knee.
A setup claims a TOP_K-caused performance effect without a matching comparison object.

canonical_sources.locator: body lever 1: GPU TOP_K fix, ne=1024 knee, PR #26592/#27466 refs, +38-53% at 24k
canonical_sources.note: Builder discussion recording the knee diagnosis and both fix paths.

note: Canonical technique identity only. A setup-specific claim must still carry its own statement, source, locator, lineage, evidence level, and contrast kind.
